mentions.name: Engineering ROI Tools & Formulas
mentions.description: A set of tools and standard formulas for assigning ROI to engineering projects with recognizable but diffuse impact, such as security and SRE work that reduces risk or empowers other teams. It aims to demonstrate a more accurate view of a team's or department's overall ROI. The bulk is planned to be open-sourced, with an optional hosted service for those who don't want to self-manage it.
mentions.problem: It is hard to calculate a dollar figure for projects like security or SRE work that lack a direct impact on conversions or revenue, yet reduce risk and empower other teams to operate more safely or move faster.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on a set of tools and standard formulas that can be applied to these cases and demonstrate a more accurate view of a team's or department's overall ROI.  The plan is to open-source the bulk of it, but provide a hosted service for folks who don't want to manage it themselves.
mentions.author: jawns
